q: How do I book a first visit?
a: Usually by phone: the patient tells us about their concerns and together we try to meet their needs (emergency, planned visit, etc.). Alternatively you can write on WhatsApp or send a request from the Book page, suggesting a preferred day and time: either way, our front desk will contact you as soon as possible to arrange the appointment. Contact details are on the Contact page.

q: When do I receive a quote?
a: Quotes are normally given directly at the practice, after the first visit and, if needed, a panoramic X-ray.
Payments can be made at the practice by cheque or cash, by card terminal (POS) or by bank transfer.

q: Which specialities are practised at the practice?
a: All the specialities of dentistry: conservative dentistry, endodontics, implantology and oral surgery, wisdom tooth surgery, periodontology, prosthetics, orthodontics, hygiene and whitening.
At Via Rovigo 9, 20132 Milan, near the Crescenzago metro station (MM). Opening hours are on the Contact page.

The practice is equipped with an oral scanner for taking digital impressions: in 80% of cases it avoids the traditional impression with pastes, alginates and silicones, which patients find very unpleasant.
